title: Song Pal
lyrics:
[Verse]
I speak languages in use
From Luganda to Ateso
Rutooro
Runyankole
Lugbara
Swahili and more
Each language brings a new way
To express ideas and build a day
With Luganda
I greet people
Acholi
I share stories that make people smile
Rutooro
Runyankole
Lugbara
Swahili
And more

[Chorus]
Sunflower logo
Be my song pal and sing to me
Sunflower logo
Be my song pal and sing to me
Sunflower logo
Be my song pal and sing to me
Sunflower logo
Be my song pal and sing to me
